title: Simple Box N' Bag
description: A Super Simple Bag N' Box mod
body:
A Super Simple Storage Mod. Adds a Leather Bag And a Metal Crate.

The Leather Bag is a Solution to Early Game Storage.

The Metal Crate is More of a QoL Feature. It Has More Space Than a Chest or Barrel, And Only Takes up One Block of Space. The Metal Crate Has Less Space Than the Double Chest [2 Less Rows].
